r5nynda3.baseName: Ark Mat Pre-Lit Spiral Christmas Tree with Star and Red Bow - Warm LED Lights
r5nynda3.variantName: Ark Mat Pre-Lit Spiral Christmas Tree with Star and Red Bow - Warm LED Lights
r5nynda3.sourceDescription: Transform your home into a festive wonderland with our Pre-Lit Spiral Artificial Christmas Tree (88cm x 43cm). Perfect for small living spaces, offices, apartments, or entryway decor, this unique tree features a cascading spiral evergreen silhouette that adds modern charm to traditional holiday decorating Outfitted with warm white fairy LED lights woven throughout lush green branches, this tree creates a warm, inviting glow straight out of the box. It comes fully finished with a classic illuminated star tree topper and a decorative red bow with gold lattice accents, giving you a complete holiday centrepiece without needing extra ornaments. Constructed with a durable central pole and circular base frame, it delivers stability on tables, floors, or mantels. Bring home easy, effortless holiday cheer year after year! For indoor and outdoor decorative use. Keep the tree and its electrical components away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the tree near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure all electrical connections are suitable for the intended indoor or outdoor use and follow the manufacturer's instructions. Do not use the product if the lights, cables, plugs or other components are damaged. Keep electrical connections protected from moisture where required and do not handle plugs or electrical connections with wet hands. Switch off and disconnect the tree from the power supply before assembly, adjustment, cleaning or storage. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children. Ensure the tree is securely assembled and positioned on a stable, level surface to prevent it from tipping over. Do not leave the product unattended if it shows signs of electrical damage or overheating. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom
